title: Judgment on Damascus
description: The Lord proclaims judgment against Damascus. Hamath and Arpad are seized with fear at the bad news; Damascus is paralyzed and struck with anguish like a woman in labor. The city's young men and warriors will fall, and the Lord will set fire to its walls that will consume Ben-Hadad's palaces. [ref:Jer 49:23-27|Jeremiah 49:23-27]
